name: @vyaz/renderer
description: SVG renderer for @vyaz/core layout output — text lines and TableFrame grids, four presets (flat/browser/preserve/glyph), plus registerFont() for keeping engine metrics and document.fonts in sync.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun && bun build ./src/index.browser.ts --outdir ./dist --outfile ./dist/index.browser.js --target browser --external @vyaz/core && tsc -b
